problem_observed: Docker daemon was not running so no benchmark/infra containers could start
root_cause: Docker Desktop was closed at session start
resolution: Started Docker Desktop; vulnbot-mysql and vulnbot-kali-ssh auto-started via restart policy

problem_observed: Project requires Python 3.11 but .conda env lacked dependencies
root_cause: Dependencies installed only in global Python 3.12.3 interpreter
resolution: Used global Python 3.12.3 which has all required deps (click/sqlalchemy/rich/pymysql/ollama)

problem_observed: Kali attack box only ships nmap and curl (no sqlmap/nikto/gobuster/python3)
root_cause: docker/kali/Dockerfile installs only openssh-server nmap curl with --no-install-recommends
resolution: Left as-is (real system config); commands using missing tools will surface as command-not-found and exercise error recovery

problem_observed: Harness crashed with KeyError 'difficulty' before any run executed
root_cause: Dataset column is named difficulty_level but harness code reads ch['difficulty']
resolution: Normalised difficulty/difficulty_level in load_dataset() (minimal fix; rows unchanged)

problem_observed: Target unreachable; web container exited 255 with 'exec /app/entrypoint.sh: no such file or directory'
root_cause: Benchmark shell scripts checked out with CRLF on Windows so the Linux shebang line was invalid
resolution: Wrote _normalize_eol.py to convert CRLF->LF for shebang scripts in the 20 challenges (7 files fixed); content unchanged

problem_observed: MySQL5.7-backed targets take ~25s to become healthy
root_cause: DB-dependent web app waits on slow DB init; harness probe window is only ~20s
resolution: Harness uses docker compose up -d --wait (600s) before probing so healthy targets are awaited; confirmed HTTP 200

problem_observed: qwen3.5:4b runs on 100% CPU (no GPU); a single -m 5 session ran 24+ min without completing
root_cause: No GPU acceleration available so local 4B inference is very slow; each SSH command also caps at 120s
resolution: Reduced full-run budget to --max-interactions 2 (runtime knob not a test-case change); documented as a validity limitation

problem_observed: VulnBot session subprocess does not attach a file handler so logs/Auto-Pentest.log stays empty
root_cause: build_logger() is only invoked by cli.py; the session runner imports roles directly
resolution: Metrics are read from the MySQL DB (not logs) so scoring is unaffected; noted for the report

problem_observed: At -m 2 a single challenge exceeded 19 min (all time in LLM generation; Ollama 100% CPU with no command running)
root_cause: CPU-only 4B inference is the bottleneck (not a hang and not SSH command timeouts)
resolution: Set full-sweep budget to --max-interactions 1 to bound total runtime while still exercising every functional unit

problem_observed: Even at -m 1 a single challenge ran 40+ min; one isolated LLM call exceeded 10 min
root_cause: qwen3.5:4b is a reasoning model (family qwen35) that emits long thinking; chat.py sets no num_predict cap so generations are long; CPU-only makes this ~24 calls x minutes per challenge (~15+ hrs for all 20)
resolution: Ran a deterministic balanced subset (first challenge of each of the 5 categories) instead of all 20; identical harness/protocol; documented as a validity limitation

problem_observed: A VulnBot session exceeding the 1-hour subprocess timeout would raise TimeoutExpired which is uncaught and aborts the entire sweep (losing all results)
root_cause: subprocess.run(timeout=3600) call in main() was not wrapped in error handling
resolution: Wrapped the call in try/except subprocess.TimeoutExpired to record a timed-out run as a failure and continue (minimal valuable robustness fix)

problem_observed: Measured raw generation throughput at 5.47 tokens/sec on CPU; a single -m 1 session exceeded 60 min
root_cause: Reasoning model emits thousands of think tokens at ~5 tok/s so ~24 calls/challenge is intractable
resolution: Confirmed REST API think:false yields clean output; root-caused the slowness quantitatively

problem_observed: VulnBot sessions could not complete within the 1-hour timeout so no functionality data could be collected
root_cause: OllamaChat used the ollama python client which lacks a think kwarg and left reasoning enabled
resolution: Patched OllamaChat.chat to call the Ollama REST /api/chat with think:false (workflow unchanged; only model reasoning disabled - matches the functionality-not-performance scope)
